rv.t: A little hard to find and the food takes time since there’s only one lady working. Having said that, it’s a very comfortable place to wait, and the simple, delicious food is well worth waiting for. Try the tiramisu, it’s perfect. (No photo since I ate it too quickly…)
Such a charming cafe! Everything is presented so beautifully, and tastes delicious! I love all the special little details they put into everything. Will definitely be back!

Truly lovely! It’s a little walk up the hill to a sweet little house with a garden and amazing views. The desserts were so tasty and cute, and lovingly made. We got the Apple French toast, the ice cheesecake and the winter parfait. The garden is beautiful. The owner was so kind. Thank you for such a lovely visit! Will definitely be back when we can!

rv.t: What a surprise in Kamakura! Relaxing vibes, high quality of food and good service. We love the garden of this cafe and the cute tiny entrance. Tomato and cheese is a must try item.

Had a really great time in EGAO. You can get authentic japanese western food (with Kamakura twist) here, and the food quality is soooooo good! The atmosphere, environment is really relaxing and nice. Staff (who was operating the restaurant alone on the day i visited) was really polite and professional, although it was a really busy lunch hour. Highly recommended!
Quick stop after visiting the beach. Nicely done place. Enjoyed our coffee with a view here.

rv.t: We stopped here on a whim while walking by. So glad we did. The workers were so kind and helpful. We tried the yuzu soda and seasonal drink. Both were delicious. This is a beautiful place with such a serene and calm atmosphere. I highly recommend grabbing a drink and relaxing here. Cashless only

Please support this place! Randomly stumbled upon this place heading to the local shrine. Absolutely amazing host with amazing gluten free drinks and baked goods. Atmosphere was amazing especially if you go right when they open.

This was such a lovely way to experience Japanese culture, the tea, dessert and the beautiful seating and views honesty made it one of my favourite memories I’ve had on my trip to Japan. I highly recommend you visit this cafe if your ever in Kamakura 🍵🤍

Guests mention the staff are welcoming and attentive, contributing to a pleasant and unhurried…
3017.edj: このティールームを訪れた人は、本格的なイングリッシュスコーンを高く評価しています。温かいスコーンには、自家製ジャムとクロテッドクリームがたっぷりと添えられており、風味豊かな紅茶も種類豊富に用意されているようです。また、アンティーク家具が配された居心地の良い店内や、穏やかな庭の眺めも特徴で、リラックスできる雰囲気を作り出しているというクチコミが多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、丁寧な対応で、ゆったりとした時間を過ごせるという感想があります。

rv.t: The scones were so delicious, as I’m craving these scones again… They were freshly baked and went so well with the butter and apple jam. I also really like the vibes of this cafe, with the large windows showing the greenery of the garden. It was so relaxing, I recommend this cafe for people who want to spend some quiet time away from the hustle and bustle of Kamakura’s touristy areas.
The cream tea I had was absolutely brilliant. You should ale a visit if you’re in the area.

📍鎌倉駅から徒歩7分 🫖クリームティー ￥1,900 週末のおやつの時間に伺ったので1時間並んだものの、待つ価値のあるいい雰囲気のカフェでした。今回はクリームティーを注文。クリームティーとはスコーンと紅茶のセットのことで、スコーンは1個か2個か選べ、紅茶も6種類から選べます。さらにポットかマグカップかも選択できるのが嬉しいポイント。焼き立ての手作りスコーンは香りが豊かで、今まで食べたスコーンの中で一番と感じるほどのおいしさでした。紅茶との相性も申し分ありません。また、猫が時々来るという噂も本当で、ふらっと姿を見せてくれた瞬間には思わず和みます。並ぶ理由がよく分かる、満足度の高いカフェでした。

rv.t: I was here last week for lunch while in Kamakura. The sandwich was good and fresh for me. The cafe has such a calm and cozy atmosphere. The staff also so friendly. Really enjoy my time here.
A quiet coffee shop tucked away down a lane. We loved the Japanese garden, peaceful setting and ambience. The food and service were good too!

rv.a: สิทธิชัย1002 จีนประชา
rv.t: It's a cafe where you feel warm and welcome upon entering, with sincere service.

3019.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、わらび餅やアップルパイなどの手作りデザートと、豊富な種類のドリンクが高く評価されています。デザートとドリンクのセットが驚くほど手頃な価格で提供されている点も特徴です。また、居心地の良い昔ながらの日本家屋の雰囲気や、親切で温かいスタッフの対応も好評のようです。

rv.t: We stumbled upon the Cafe after visiting the Zeniarai Benten Shrine. It is a converted 95 years old house that has retained its old charm and provides diners with a relaxed homey atmosphere. The owner runs the cafe on Tuesdays and Saturdays only so we were very lucky to have come across it. The teas were very good and the desserts we had were excellent. The prices are so reasonable, it shows the owner runs the cafe…

Everything I ate and drank was delicious. The place has a lovely traditional view. I actually left my glasses (the ones in the photo) behind, and the owner ran all the way after me to return them. She is truly such a friendly and hospitable person

This place is truly a gem. The amount of care and effort that the owner invests in looking after their guests is something special. It’s a great place to relax and slow down when in Kamakura. Foreign tourists, please be sure to obey the signs and customs

rv.t: Fantastic cafe tucked away in a quiet corner of Kamakura. It doesn't appear to be a cafe from the outside if you are having difficulty finding it via maps, but the pin is correct. They have a limited menu but everything here tasted great. I would caution anyone over six foot/180cm in height, the ceilings are low while entering and using the lavatory.

Love love love it here The food was great, heartily and wonderfully made! The atmosphere, amazing! We were here on Tuesday about 1230pm, there was another 2 groups inside that were already finishing up. We could take our time with our food :) You can get the set meal that comes with dessert + tea, and a random vintage plate to bring back :)

A traditional Japanese house turned into a very nice cozy cafe. There’s no major sign and it looks like a regular residence, you might miss the entrance. They offer lunch menus using locally grown vegetables and organic ingredients. The medicinal curry plate and Japanese Oden plate are both excellent choice. Reservation recommended.

rv.t: came to ine for a short stop, strolling around and found this coffee stand, we tried their rich matcha latte and its soooo good!!!! the staffs are super friendly too. interested with their doughnuts so we show them the muslim card and the staff verified with us that there is no non-halal ingredients in the doughnuts so we bought it! yey and its surprisingly good too, its kinda reminds me of biskut raya aiskrim…

Great coffee and even better doughnut. This place is able to serve the food quickly after ordering. You first order what you want, pay and receive your food. You could then cross the road and enjoy a beautiful sea view with you food and drinks. Would recommend to come here for the delicious doughnut and drink!

Ordered Americano and Hot Matcha Latte to enjoy the view next to the bay. Such a calming a chill environment, enjoying good coffee and matcha. Eventho I only chose rich matcha latte (i believe it’s not the ceremonial grade) the taste of the matcha is already so good. They use 6g of matcha and I chose less sweet. The “ceremonial” grade costs 1.2K yen. You can taste the umami, seaweedy, oceanic, slight nuttiness of…

We made our reservation almost 6 months in advance, and from that moment onwards, Shibata-san, the restaurant manager, was the absolute best! She made planning so simple and was very helpful throught the entire process by helping us with flexible buffet options, food restirctions of some of the guests, and table arrangements. The food and service…

We walked in around opening without a reservation and they were able to accommodate us. There is a set area for people without reservations and it filled up quite quickly. Service is mediocre. We ended up getting our food before we even got waters. We had to ask one of the crew members running by if we were able to get waters as there is no table service. You just order from your phone. Drinks were very good in the…

It’s in a nice spot and if you can get a riverside view, it’s a lovely place to spend the evening. If you have a dog they have a section for pets and their owners. Wasn’t impressed by the food, it wasn’t bad but with all the rave reviews I was expecting it to be great, it wasn’t. For the price I’d expect better, none of the dishes were outstanding, the same fare as you could get at any other westernized restaurant…

rv.t: The food here just gave me a major flashback to my time in Taiwan! Really authentic and tasty, highly recommend! I tried both the original flavour doujiang (豆漿） and the salty one (鹹豆漿） and both are just great in their own way. I feel like the plain flavour is not as filling and thick as in Taiwan, but a little bit more “watery” which I enjoyed at this hot and humid Tokyo weather. The salty one is perfect, just rich…

This is a Must Go, if Chinese breakfast is your thing. One of the best bowls of Salty soy milk I've ever had. Odd to find this Gem in Tokyo. It's like they have the Authentic Chinese taste paired with the Japanese refinement. All their stuff is made in house, which makes it more amazing. Their fan tuan was legitimately the best I've ever had. The cruller was well dried and crispy, lots of pickled vegetables and even…

Cozy Taiwanese breakfast spot in Tokyo 🇹🇼 I went around 9:30 a.m. on a weekday. There were already a few people in line, and it took about 20 minutes before I could place my order. Since seating is only available after ordering, some people were waiting near the cashier as well. Luckily, we were able to get seats right away. I tried the traditional soy milk soup and a sesame-filled grilled dumpling. Both were just…

rv.t: One of the places we can try Taiwanese style brkfast in Tokyo. The queue already when i got there at 8:30am, nevertheless Lu Rou Fan still available. As to the food option, no complaints. Saw some left negative reviews for the menu on the post tho. Staff are very attentive and careful. Taste is good, but weak star anise scent is exactly what I got disappointed. So i would say 8 out of 10, considering great staff…

Finally got to indulge in a traditional Taiwanese breakfast after years, and it didn't disappoint! The owner's warmth and friendliness instantly transported me back to Taiwan. The menu boasted a wide variety of breakfast options, blending Taiwanese flavors with a Japanese twist – a smart move considering its location in Japan and the primary Japanese clientele. While the fusion might not be everyone's cup of tea, I…

For reference, I am Taiwanese born and raised. I think the 蛋餅 feels a little doughy and the 蘿蔔糕 (大根餅) feels a little underfried/doughy as well. The 豆漿 feels very sweet. I wouldn’t call this place very authentic but it’s one of the better ones I’ve had in Tokyo.

rv.t: Hidden gem and absolutely worth a visit. The location right by the water makes it feel peaceful and special from the moment you arrive. The rooms are impressively spacious and come with all the amenities you might need, making the stay very comfortable. The restaurant was a pleasant surprise, with dishes that are very well suited to a western palate, and the wine selection really stands out since the owner is a…

Fantastic location, food and accommodation. Unbelievable bottle wine list for connoisseurs; reasonable per glass prices for everyone else ;-) Also serves wine from the nearby amanohashidate winery. Food is a first rate French-inspired course menu. Gorgeous, spacious private onsen bath with attached outside rotemburo. Tastefully appointed suite in a historic building overlooking the canal and rotating bridge. Staff…

Delicious western style dinner and good Japanese style breakfast. Great view at the room with massage chair. Small hot spring but should be enough if the hotel is not full. Since the hotel is not very big, no group tourists will stay here so that you can enjoy your holiday quietly.

rv.t: When I stepped into the café/bakery, the first sensation wasn’t sweetness, it was geological coolness. Platforms ripple like exposed strata, and the counter undulates, spilling into the bread-making area and then into the seating. There’s a strange fluidity created from something that is supposedly solid and heavy. I admire the boldness. But it pulls so far from the familiar comfort of a bakery. Seeing breads…

I went to “I’m donut” (both Tokyo and Fukuoka branches) before so I have no expectations for this store but my friends want to come so I thought “let’s go”😂 However, I got better experience than I’m donut. The breads were all tasty and the display looked appetizing, big selection for all tastes. The size of the breads is small so it’s easy to try a few kinds for sharing,. I had a takeout but eat-in looks good too with open kitchen settings. The staff were friendly.

rv.t: If you are exploring Kappabashi Street in Tokyo and start feeling tired after a long walk, this café is the perfect place to take a break. The interior is stylish yet comfortable, creating a peaceful environment away from the busy streets outside. Whether you are…

First off the cafe itself is really nice, the aesthetic is kind of rustic and dark with this gritty but still classy cozy vibe, like earthy but in a moody way, and it actually works. We sat outside even though there were seats indoors because the weather was perfect and it was already our second matcha latte of the day so we were just taking it easy. The matcha color in person was great, deep and vibrant, even if…

What a gorgeous place - arty, chilled, random and with THE best sound system! If you want to escape the hustle and bustle of ‘kitchen street’, this is the ideal place. We had a soy latte (Bonsoy) and a regular milk cappuccino - both delicious. It’s obvious that care and thought has gone into the customer experience here because our drinks came in tactile, handsome pottery cup/saucer sets. Make sure you visit…

The listing made it seem like we had a room with a private onsen and a view of the bay, but when we arrived, we were told we had a basic room with only a shower and a view of a concrete wall. It seems multiple room types or buildings may be…

Perfect for us 4 people. I was quite nervous at first because of the location and we check in late night but the surprise we get after entering the room was out of our expectation. The room was so Clean and the staff guide us so Nicely with each and every detail. It was worth booking Japanese style hotel. You feel like you own the whole house and you can stay with your family and friends. Separate floor gives you…
the stay is fantastic. My Wife and I love it so much. Wake up with the seaview! One of the memorable night I had in Japan

Definitely something I'd go back for! Note that the cafe requires 1 drink per person. While it wasn't an issue for us, options are quite limited if you don't drink caffeine.

I had the best experience in this cafe. Came here almost everyday since we discovered this place randomly, had the amazing breakfast and the amazing hospitality. Their breakfast menu that starts at 8.30 till 11.00 was super filling. Two person was 12,57, which is super nice for a go to. The atmosphere is amazing, I will miss this place. :(

My aim is to take the boat, too bad its not in service, nor knowing why. Sawara is a little small town, looks like a silent town with many shops looks like not operating. The only place with people is along the canal. If you like quiet town, maybe you will like it.

We took the Little Edo Sawara boat tour and it was such a great experience. We caught the last boat of the day around 4 PM, and even though we didn’t speak the language, the staff were very accommodating and tried their best to explain the historic sights and passages we were floating through. You will get greasy and stinky. 🦨😅 If I came again I'd get the all you can eat salad bar, with curry etc... rv.t: 閉店間際1人で来店、申し訳なさを感じながら着席した。案内は丁寧でいい雰囲気だと思っていたのも束の間、出てきた寿司のレベルが悪すぎる。はっきり言って食べたくならない。飲食店としてこれで金もらうのはおかしくないだろうか？値段の安さは素晴らしいが衛生を無視して出来てます！というのが店のやり方なのであれば納得の値段である。巻物は中トロ鉄火巻を頼んだはずなのだがこれで合ってるのか？巻物は全て残した。1品料理は美味い、安いし素晴らしいと思った。すしと店名に入れずにや台料理に改名したらどうかと思う、それならばこんなネタが出てきてもしょうがないか、と腑に落ちるんじゃないだろうか。閉店間際に来る客は片付けの時間が削られるからムカついたりするのもわかるが、あまりにも舐めすぎだと思う。このお店に行くのであれば横にある庄屋の方がマシ

兎に角、注目したのに料理が来ない。 他に客は2組位でガラガラにもら関わらず全く来ない。お通しが来てから直ぐに注文してるのにも関わらず40分以上、何も来ない。 ムカついたのですぐにお会計で店を出ました。お会計も定員が目の前に入るのに後ろ向いててパソコンだが携帯だがをいじっていてこっち向かない。何回もテーブルを叩いてやりました。全く無反応。周りの客も注目するくらいなのに気が付かないから、おい！って言ったらようやくお会計。ですが、なんも反応無しで金額のみを言ってきたので呆れて何も言う気になれませんでした。もう2度と行きません。

回転ずしではなく 職人さんが握ってくれるお寿司をお手軽に食べられる居酒屋さんかな ハッピーアワーもあって早く来店すると 飲み物が安くなる 開店から19時まで 寿司は🍣美味しいまではないかな 普通にいただきました。 店員さんは元気な方が多く感じました。 オーダーは最初は店員さん あとのオーダーは携帯からしました！ 呼ばなくていいのは嬉しい✨ 残念な点が2つ 1.カウンターに置かれている皿が汚れている （たぶん食洗機から直 拭いてない） （写真添付 いくらか綺麗な皿と拭きあげてない皿 2種類皿があるがどちらもおなじだった） 2.カウンターの幅が長いので寿司までが遠い （寿司を置いてくれるところまで手が届かない） コスパは良いお店でした。

rv.t: I came in with my boyfriend and 2 friends today and we are all from California. We were instantly greeted, seated, and met with friendly service from the workers and friendly customers as well. All of our food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully made. One of our friends hadnt tried sushi properly before and he really enjoyed it. One of the customers bought us some yummy egg too! I really recommend this place. The…

You can eat very good sushi. The sushi has a gentle taste. The miso soup is made with Sakura miso. For lunch, I had the special nigiri sushi. I really don't want to tell you about it, but I recommend it.

Thank you for the great experience, delicious sushi and conversation. It was a pleasure to immerse in the social aspect of sushi restaurants in such a friendly and welcoming way. Greetings from Portugal ✌🏽😊

3043.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

3044.a: Sakura Castle Ruins Park, 官有無番地 Jonaicho, Sakura, Chiba 285-0017, Japan
3044.aj: 〒285-0017 千葉県佐倉市城内町官有無番地 佐倉城址公園
3044.ed: A ruined castle tower & moat sit among maple & cherry trees in a park popular for picnics.
3044.edj: モミジや桜の木に囲まれたピクニックに人気の公園。天守閣跡や空堀がある。

rv.t: It's more a beautiful park than castle ruins, but it's on the site that was a Castle in Edo period, then military barracks, which were destroyed post WW2. Now a large park for lovely walks but the moats and earth walls are still visible.
A really pleasant nature experience! They mean it when they say ruins - there is no semblance of any castles. Just random staircases and statues throughout the park. Still really nice though!

Scenic castle ruins. Not much remains of the actual castle, but the grounds and moat are picturesque and well maintained. Worth noting that the nearby museum of Japanese history is closed on Mondays, though the castle grounds remain open to explore.

3045.aj: 〒285-0017 千葉県佐倉市城内町５−２３ ひよどり坂
3045.ed: Visitors say this samurai pathway features a beautiful, well-maintained bamboo forest that evokes a sense of stepping back into the Edo period. They also highlight the peaceful and quiet atmosphere, making it a relaxing escape. Guests mention it's an excellent spot for photography and pairs well with nearby samurai houses and museums.
3045.edj: このサムライの小道は、美しく手入れされた竹林が特徴で、江戸時代にタイムスリップしたような感覚を味わえるとクチコミがあります。静かで落ち着いた雰囲気も高く評価されており、リラックスできる場所として人気です。写真撮影にも最適なスポットで、近くの武家屋敷や博物館と合わせて訪れるのがおすすめという声も多く聞かれます。

rv.t: I decided to visit the bamboo forest slope and Old Samurai residences after a run to Narita airport. It was certainly worth the 15-20 minute drive off the route to see both, though the slope was much shorter than I expected. The staff at the residences were excellent—very personable and offering extra information about the lives of the samurai and the families who would have occupied these homes.

This bamboo forest has historical significance as a samurai pathway and is beautiful without the crowds of tourists! Sssh Don’t tell too many people that it is like mini Arashiyama bamboo forest in a residential neighborhood. Free entry. The temperature is noticeably cooler by 5 degrees and feels like a natural air conditioner. Listen to cicadas? Feel the breeze, Sit for a while until you get bitten by tiny…

Loved this visit! Stopped by on my birthday and it was such a nice little day trip from Tokyo. There are samurai houses along the way that you can visit, but the bamboo forest is very cool. Reminded me a lot of Arashiyama, but much closer to Tokyo.

3046.a: Sumida Park, 1 Chome-3 Mukojima, Sumida City, Tokyo 131-0033, Japan
3046.aj: 〒131-0033 東京都墨田区向島１丁目３ 隅田公園
3046.ed: People say this park is beautifully maintained and offers stunning views of the Tokyo Skytree, especially with seasonal cherry blossoms or autumn leaves. They also highlight the spacious, relaxing atmosphere, making it ideal for walks, picnics, and enjoying nature. Others also mention the clean restrooms and the variety of events and food trucks available on weekends.
3046.edj: この公園を利用した人は、手入れが行き届いていて美しいと評価しています。特に、桜の季節や紅葉の時期には、東京スカイツリーの素晴らしい景色が楽しめると評判です。園内は広々としていてリラックスできる雰囲気のため、散歩やピクニック、自然を満喫するのに最適という声が多くあります。また、清潔なトイレが整備されていることや、週末にはさまざまなイベントやキッチンカーが出店することも魅力として挙げられています。

rv.t: A nice spot for a peaceful stroll along the river. I visited outside of cherry blossom season, so it was quiet and not crowded—a relaxing break from the busy city streets. A couple of highlights nearby worth mentioning: Komagatado Hall – a striking temple with beautiful architecture tucked just off the park path. Worth a quick stop. Ubagaike Pond – a small, serene pond located on the way from Senso-ji Temple to…
There is always something going on at this park. When we visited, there were plenty of great food trucks. Also, plenty of cherry trees for you to enjoy in the spring.
Visit on March 26, 2026. Beautiful park, there is alot of cherry blossoms blooming now with a great view of skytree. Should full bloom within the next few days.

3047.a: Japan, 〒131-0045 Tokyo, Sumida City, Oshiage, 1 Chome−27−1 TASxCOFFEE
3047.aj: 〒131-0045 東京都墨田区押上１丁目２７−１ TASxCOFFEE
catj: コーヒー スタンド
コーヒー ショップ
3047.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and fresh sandwiches, especially the egg and chicken options, and its aromatic coffee. They also highlight the cozy and quaint atmosphere, noting it's a great spot for a relaxing break. Guests mention the staff are very kind and welcoming, providing excellent service.
3047.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮で美味しいサンドイッチ、特に卵とチキンが人気です。香り高いコーヒーも高く評価されています。居心地の良い、趣のある雰囲気が特徴で、リラックスした休憩にぴったりの場所という声が多くあります。スタッフはとても親切で感じが良く、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているという感想が多くあります。

rv.t: Wonderfully cozy cafe with great food and friendly owners! I tried the ham and cheese sandwich, and the chicken sandwich - both amazing and fresh. The seasonal drink was the purple sweet potato latte and I had the iced version which was uniquely yummy! It’s a short walk from SKYTREE, but there are only 4 seats. If it’s full, definitely have some to take-out because I’m still thinking of the sandwiches a few days…

Wonderful chicken sandwich using fresh ingredients made when ordered. Super efficient and friendly owner/operator. Small cafe, seats 4 inside. Luckily I was there early and it wasn't too busy. I would definitely come back!
If you’re going to Skytree - come to this place first! Amazing Egg Sando and a delicious corn soup. Super chill vibes, pretty small inside. Super tasty food and great coffee!

3048.a: Japan, 〒130-0002 Tokyo, Sumida City, Narihira, 4 Chome−18−16 Mr.Bakeman Bake&coffee
3048.aj: 〒130-0002 東京都墨田区業平４丁目１８−１６ Mr.Bakeman Bake&coffee
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
3048.ed: Low-key eatery with tables & counter seating, serving a menu of banana-centric sandwiches & sweets.
3048.edj: バナナをメインにしたサンドイッチとスイーツを提供する、落ち着いた雰囲気のカフェ。テーブル席とカウンター席がある。

rv.t: This place has been on list for a while and feels like you’re in the middle of nowhere, but it’s a stones throw from sky tree. Much like many cafes here it is very clean and modern (a lot of concrete and sharp lines) with some nice wood accents. Some feel cold but this place felt comfortable and inviting. People working were very nice. A solid cup of coffee and the sweet potato waffle was very good. Granola bowl was…

Light lunch near the Tokyo skytree - the pastries are their selling point. - seasonal tiramisu looked generous in portion and was chestnut flavoured - we got the sweet potato roll cake which really tasted of the sweet potato and was very light. The sponge was a tad dry. - hot dog had mashed potatoes within the bun which was cute - the most interesting was the “butter sand” sandwich which was peanut butter, bacon AND…

I was trying to find a good place for brunch around the Tokyo Sky Tree and found this place. It took more than an hour to get a seat, and after the waiting… the food just amazed me. Simple crunchy cheese toast with fried egg on top brought me to life. So so good, everything on point. Totally recommended, if you have time, of course.

3049.a: tomoru, 1 Chome-12-4 Oshiage, Sumida City, Tokyo 131-0045, Japan
3049.aj: 〒131-0045 東京都墨田区押上１丁目１２−４ tomoru
3049.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious tantanmen noodles, which offer customizable levels of spiciness and numbing sensation, along with flavorful gyoza. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the cozy, local atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are very friendly and provide excellent service.
3049.edj: この担々麺店を利用した人は、辛さと痺れを調整できる担々麺と、風味豊かな餃子を高く評価しています。手頃な価格と居心地の良いアットホームな雰囲気も特徴のようです。スタッフはとても親切で、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Hands-down one of the best bowls of noodles I have ever had. Such a small, unassuming, quaint little restaurant but the flavours are big, bold, and powerful by contrast. Was thoroughly blown away by the flavours, will be returning before we return from our trip.
I just want to leave a review because the owner had the nicest smile and energy and me and my husband loved his ramen. Thank you! The best ramen to end our trip with.

The front doesn't have a visible sign, but you'll know based on Google maps. The interior takes you back in time. There were two middle-aged men. There isl a sink toward the back on the right for washing hands. The owner was very friendly and sincere, unlike some establishments are polite and friendly, but there is no sincerity. He actually spoke decent English, and even showed me how to eat the noodles. The food…

3049.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

3050.a: Okimaro, 1 Chome-18-4 Narihira, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0002, Japan
3050.aj: 〒130-0002 東京都墨田区業平１丁目１８−４ おきまろ
3050.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Okinawan dishes, including flavorful taco rice, juicy Agu pork gyoza, and hearty Okinawa soba with chewy noodles. They also highlight the cozy, Okinawan-themed atmosphere with island music, and the friendly, attentive staff. Guests mention the reasonable prices and the convenience of being dog-friendly indoors.
3050.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、風味豊かなタコライス、ジューシーなアグー豚餃子、もちもち麺の沖縄そばなど、美味しい沖縄料理を高く評価しています。また、沖縄の音楽が流れる居心地の良い沖縄風の雰囲気や、親切で気の利くスタッフも好評のようです。手頃な価格設定や、犬を連れて店内に入れる利便性も評価されています。

rv.t: Thank you Okimaro! The staff were great, super intuitive and mindful of timing. Ordering is completed via a QR code, which is innately super foreigner friendly. Atmosphere is nice;set by soft music, cozy interior furnitures and Okinawan posts, and via displays. The food was incredible and came out in a timely manner. And yes, 2 minutes from Skytree. Thank you for creating a space that feels like a home away from…

By far, my favorite place! We had several snake shots, dumplings, fried rice, chicken, pickled vegetables, and numerous other things. Our server was very attentive and made sure everything was right. This restaurant is small but it isn’t lacking in the flavor department. I recommend coming with a couple of people and trying a few things off the menu. Everything is reasonably priced & it’s right by Tokyo Skytree.
A small diner, but quite cozy and with great food! The price is very reasonable. The staff are very friendly as well. It is a rare gem in the busy oshiage area. Highly recommended!!

3050.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3051.a: Japan, 〒130-0002 Tokyo, Sumida City, Narihira, 4 Chome−3−10 1F Station213(tomoni.住吉に移転）
3051.aj: 〒130-0002 東京都墨田区業平４丁目３−１０ 1F Station213(tomoni.住吉に移転）

rv.t: 2025/4/27訪問 Pasta ポルチーニ茸のクリームソース 1800円 本日のおつまみ 盛り合わせ(少量サイズ) 700円 3度目の訪問。 軽くつまんでビールからのパスタ。 ポルチーニ茸ゴロゴロ、 濃厚なソースが平麺によく絡みます！ 美味😋 ご馳走様でした。 2025/2/15訪問 Pasta ほたるいかと菜の花のペペロンチーノ 1300円 お肉たっぷりボロネーゼ 1300円 Pizza マルゲリータ 1300円 本日のランチは、業平4丁目 2度目の訪問。 パスタもピッツァも美味しい！ まだまだ食べたいメニューがたくさん。 次回はポルチーニ茸を食べよう。 美味😋 ご馳走様でした。 Pasta お肉たっぷりボロネーゼ 1300円 本日のランチは、業平4丁目 Bar cura @cura_yuki で間借り営業しているイタリアカフェ。 ゴロッとしたお肉たっぷりボロネーゼソースは食べ応えあります🍝 アルデンテ加減も👍️ 美味😋…

・ボロネーゼとモッツァレラのピッツァ（サラダ付） デザートセット（ガトーショコラとコーヒー） ・ボンゴレビアンコ（サラダ付） デザートセット（ほろにがプリンとコーヒー） ピッツァにはスモーキーな香りがついたボロネーゼがたっぷりでモッツァレラがとても合います。 ガトーショコラはハードでヘビー（濃厚と言う意味です）。軽めで酸味の効いたアメリカンな味わいのコーヒーとよく合います。 ボンゴレビアンコはアサリのエキスが濃厚。 プリンはオールドスタイルの硬めでカラメルが深い。 それぞれセットで2000円弱。 街イタリアンとして優秀だと思います

ランチタイムに間借りしている、絶品イタリアン。 毎回パスタを頼んでデザートセットにします。 パスタは定番メニューもありますが、期間限定メニューも多いので行くたびに違うメニューになっています。 バスクチーズケーキ美味しい！！ 絶対にセットにするべきです。 パスタはズッキーニとベーコンのペペロンチーノ、お肉たっぷりボロネーゼを別日に頼みました。 どちらも美味しくて毎回パスタ何食べようか迷います。 美味しかったです。

3052.a: Kintarō Sushi Kinshicho, 1 Chome-27-9 Taihei, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0012, Japan
3052.aj: 〒130-0012 東京都墨田区太平１丁目２７−９ 金太楼鮨 錦糸町店
3052.edj: カウンター席とテーブル席に加え、個室も完備している。旬の魚介類を使用した寿司や刺身が味わえる。日本酒や焼酎の種類も豊富。

rv.t: Nice little sushi spot ~15 minutes away from Skytree. The nigiri sushi was very good! Tuna also very good!! Thank you for letting us see the uchide no kozuchi ~ Will definitely come again if in the area!! ＼(＾▽＾)／

Nice sushi place which is open later for a late lunch. The rare stuff such uni or otoro i would say that you can pass since it is just good. The stuff more on the simple side is actually quiet fresh maybe because it sells better. Bill was 3800 per person with a beer. Reasonable price. I recommend it.

A well hidden little sushi restaurant, located half-way between Kinshicho station and the Tokyo Sky Tree. The fish is cut and arranged right before your eyes, fresh and tasty. Not the cheapest (lunch menu at 6.000¥ per person, for a generous set + excellent sake), but the quality is well worth the money. Definitely not for mass tourism. The decor is appealing, and you can choose to eat either by the bar, or at the…

3052.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

3053.a: Konica Minolta Planetarium “TENKU” in Tokyo Skytree Town®, 東京スカイツリータウン・イーストヤード 7階 1 Chome-1-2 Oshiage, Sumida City, Tokyo 131-0045, Japan
3053.aj: 〒131-0045 東京都墨田区押上１丁目１−２ 東京スカイツリータウン・イーストヤード 7階 コニカミノルタプラネタリウム天空 in 東京スカイツリータウン®
catj: アミューズメント センター
3053.ed: People say this planetarium offers diverse and immersive programs, including collaborations with artists and anime, with beautiful visuals and sound. Visitors also highlight the comfortable reclining seats, pleasant aroma, and the staff's attentive service. Other reviews mention the programs can be boring.
3053.edj: クチコミによると、このプラネタリウムは、アーティストやアニメとのコラボレーションを含む、多様で没入感のあるプログラムを提供しており、美しい映像と音響が特徴のようです。利用した人は、快適なリクライニングシート、心地よいアロマ、そしてスタッフの丁寧なサービスも高く評価しています。 一方で、プログラムの内容によっては退屈だと感じるという意見もあります。

rv.t: Its rather immersive, given the shape of the screen. We watched a doraemon show on it, it was awesome. Would recommend, as long as you either understand Japanese or dont mind not understanding what theyre saying :)

Not great… planetarium show was not educational/scientific at all, we saw the “Goodnight” show. The name really does it justice. The screen is mostly dots/stars on a black screen and calming wave sounds, would definitely put you to sleep. Staff were kind and gave good seat recommendations and the seats reclined decently far. For english speakers, there is an option for an earphones to listen to the audio in English…

Interesting starry night show. We watched 2 shows here. One was the Arabian, and the other one was the song of planetarium. We liked the song of the planetarium as the storyline was much better and touched with beautiful songs. Very relaxed and comfortable seating and ambience No recording (audio or video) during the show.

3053.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

3054.a: Ducky Duck Cafe LaLaport Tokyo Bay, ららぽーとTOKYO-BAY北館 1F 2 Chome-1-1 Hamacho, Funabashi, Chiba 273-0012, Japan
3054.aj: 〒273-0012 千葉県船橋市浜町２丁目１−１ ららぽーとTOKYO-BAY北館 1F ダッキーダックカフェ ららぽーとTokyoBay店

rv.t: The food was exactly how you would expect from the pictures. Delicious but a little small if you are coming for a full meal. We ate in the afternoon and it was quiet, the food came quickly but we had to ask for the tea later.

家族➕嫁の母と来店。平日という事もあり、ガラガラといった店内。雰囲気は明るく、入り口を入るとショーケースの中にケーキが並んでいる。とても良い感じのお店だ。 私はオムライスを注文した。 うーん。男性には物足りない量だと思う。少ない。女性は良いかもしれないけど、男性や小学生以上には、追加注文が必要。パスタとオムライスが中心で、ピザの種類は少ない。サイドメニューとしては、心許ない。 行くなら、ランチ。 ディナーではないと、思った。

平日ランチ（クリスマス25日）に利用した。牡蠣のマカロニグラタンBセットに+110円でサラダを付けてもらった。2070円（税込み）。ケーキにコーヒーが付くからけっして高くもないかもしれない。お味の方はというと牡蠣グラタンは普通に美味しい。それ以上でも以下でもないが家庭でも十分再現できる程度の味かもしれない。サラダはなんか酸っぱい香りがするなーって思ったら白いフレンチドレッシングがドバドバとかけてあった。これは「かけすぎ」でしょ。自分で好きな量をかけられるようにした方がいい。レタス自体は質のいいもので美味しいです。ケーキも安っぽいケーキだな。イマイチだった。でも美味しいケーキを望むならば価格が高いＣコースにしないとね。店内雰囲気はいいです。店員はデザートを提供するタイミングを間違わないようにそして遅くならないように頻繁にこちらの食の進み具合を確認に見えます。よく視線が合ってしまうので、これ以上多いと目障りになるかも。ららぽーとTO…

3055.a: Cafe Keimeisha Yatsu, 4 Chome-6-34 Yatsu, Narashino, Chiba 275-0026, Japan
3055.aj: 〒275-0026 千葉県習志野市谷津４丁目６−３４ cafe 螢明舎 谷津店
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
3055.ed: Diners like this cafe's unique, retro atmosphere, which feels like stepping into a novel from a past era, and appreciate the delicious coffee, tarts, and sandwiches. They also highlight the smooth and efficient service from the staff, even during busy times.
3055.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、まるで昔の小説の世界に迷い込んだかのような独特のレトロな雰囲気が高く評価されています。また、美味しいコーヒーやタルト、サンドイッチも好評です。忙しい時間帯でも、スタッフの対応がスムーズで効率的であるという声も多くあります。

rv.t: I saw this cafe featured on a tv program on the BS-TBS channel with Hiromi Terasawa so I was inspired to visit with my family. The place is so unique and has so much character so I personally find it tragic that many people complain in their reviews. Experiencing a cafe like this is so refreshing when so many cafes these days go for super modern, minimalistic (and often soulless) interiors. This cafe is so whimsy!…

I had a lovely time at this cafe. The staff was very friendly and thoughtful. My coffee and dessert were both delicious and worth the wait. And the vibe was fantastic. It felt like I had entered a secret space of calmness (quiet, low lighting, nice music) that I’ll look forward to enjoying again.
Don't be in any rush when you come here. Your coffee will take a minimum of 10 minutes to be made but it will be well worth the wait. The cafe has a great ambiance and we always love to come here.

3055.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00（土）

3056.a: Japan, 〒273-0003 Chiba, Funabashi, Miyamoto, 4 Chome−14−9 ハイツ・菊屋 Kiro Cafe
3056.aj: 〒273-0003 千葉県船橋市宮本４丁目１４−９ ハイツ・菊屋 Kiro Cafe
3056.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and voluminous sandwiches, such as the teriyaki and tamago sando, as well as their carefully brewed coffee and cute latte art. They also highlight the clean and comfortable atmosphere, with ample seating. Guests mention the staff are friendly and provide warm service, and the prices are reasonable.
3056.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、照り焼きサンドやたまごサンドなどのボリューム満点で美味しいサンドイッチ、丁寧に淹れられたコーヒー、可愛らしいラテアートが高く評価されています。店内は清潔感があり、座席数も多く、ゆったりと過ごせる快適な空間が特徴です。スタッフは親しみやすく、温かいサービスを提供しているという声が多く、価格もリーズナブルなようです。

rv.t: Excellent service. Beautiful presentation. Delicious latte and tamago sando. ☕🥚Conveniently located near the train station. 🚉 Don't skip this cafe! 🔥

I remember when I first came to Japan and was really struggling with being in a new environment, the language barrier being an issue at most. However, when I entered this cafe on a whim I was greeted with such a warm atmosphere from the staff! This cafe truly relaxed and comforted me. The food is also quite great so I genuinely recommend stopping by and at least having a cup of coffee before you go. 🤍
A wonderful cafe next to the train tracks. A great place to watch the trains come and go. Food and drinks are delicious and the service warm and friendly.

3056.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3057.a: IKEA Tokyo-Bay, 2 Chome-3-30 Hamacho, Funabashi, Chiba 273-0012, Japan
3057.aj: 〒273-0012 千葉県船橋市浜町２丁目３−３０ IKEA Tokyo-Bay
3057.ed: Scandinavian chain selling ready-to-assemble furniture, plus textiles, lighting & home decor.
3057.edj: 北欧生まれの家具のチェーン店。組み立て式家具、テキスタイル、照明、インテリア用品を販売。

rv.t: A consistent experience even in another country. This IKEA was clean, modern and had the usual IKEA staples like chairs, lamps and desk. What was more interesting in my opinion was the food court which had a menu adapted to the Japanese palate at really cheap prices on top of the staples such as meatballs.

The restaurant is great. The taste is absolute ok for that price. And they allow you to stay until 23 for learning and work. 1st floor is living hell for any male and heaven for any female. So if you like to torture and test if your guy is husband material, try the first floor.

With home renovation, I probably when to this store like over 10 times. All staff were nice and helpful other than one young Japanese girl with the kitchen planning area. She was using all excuses to not help then immediately changed her attitude once another staff came nearby. But all other staff were patient and gave very good advice! Would love to go again despite the long train ride!

3057.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

3058.a: Yatsu Rose Garden, 3 Chome-1-14 Yatsu, Narashino, Chiba 275-0026, Japan
3058.aj: 〒275-0026 千葉県習志野市谷津３丁目１−１４ 谷津バラ園
3058.ed: Tranquil park boasting a great variety of flowering roses displayed alongside pathways & fountains.
3058.edj: 歩道沿いや噴水の周りにさまざまな種類のバラが咲き誇る静かな公園。

rv.t: Very nice rose garden. Never knew there were so many varieties of roses. Beautiful.

10/10 visit. I visited on a Monday afternoon by myself and it was amazing. Flowers were in bloom and there wasn't much of a crowd, the staff/locals were amazing friendly as well, there was no wait to enter the park however tickets have to be bought from the vending machine beside the entrance, for adults it was 550yen. You can finish walking the park in about 30-45mins but I recommend sitting there to enjoy the vibe…

It is my first time visiting (2024/5/15). The roses are in full bloom! Some of the roses have already wilted a little. I think visiting this week will be the best time. It was so much fun. The garden was not too crowded (but maybe because it is weekday). It's not large in size but every roses were beautiful. There are so many varieties. My favourite is the aroma garden. It feels like bathed in rose essential oils…

3059.a: Japan, 〒273-0012 Chiba, Funabashi, Hamacho, 2 Chome−1−1 GYUKATSU and WATEISHOKU Kyoto katsugyu LaLaport TOKYO-BAY, ららぽーとＴＯＫＹＯ－ＢＡＹ北館１Ｆ
3059.aj: 〒273-0012 千葉県船橋市浜町２丁目１−１ 牛カツと和定食 京都勝牛 ららぽーとTOKYO-BAY店 ららぽーとＴＯＫＹＯ－ＢＡＹ北館１Ｆ
3059.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious fried chicken with light tartar sauce, flavorful loin cutlets, and tender beef. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the pleasant atmosphere.
3059.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、あっさりとしたタルタルソースで食べる美味しい唐揚げ、旨味のあるロースカツ、やわらかい牛肉などを高く評価しています。また、手頃な価格設定と心地よい雰囲気も評判のようです。

rv.t: Came here for lunch on a Tuesday around 1145 and wasn't busy, by the time we left was still quiet. Ordered the lunch set which includes small sirloin and mince kutsu, miso soup, salad and rice for 1485 yen with tax. It was very tasty and didn't need to use the hot plate to cook the beef. The mince kutsu was quite oily but also nice. Overall great service and food.

Got there around 11:15 and they opened at 11am. Had to wait a little bit for the first wave of people to finish. I would recommend you go to stand in line around 15 mins before if you want to be the first group in. Seems lots of people start lining up around then. I would definitely recommend you get the Tenderloin GYUKATSU ZEN meal set. The meat is softer than the Sirloin Gyukatsu. I got the tenderloin and friend…
Very friendly staff accompanied by delicious food. A nice quiet meal in the midst of large shopping scene. Come for the delicious beef dishes.
